BRAHM Drop  v1.1  —  macOS
Brahm InnerBrain Technologies Pvt. Ltd.  |  Developed by Sandeep Kushwah
=======================================================================

WHAT IT DOES
  Send files between your phone, Windows PC and Mac over the same Wi-Fi.
  No internet, no login, no ads. Files never leave your network.

HOW TO RUN
  1. Double-click  "BRAHM Drop.command"
     (It automatically uses the correct build for Intel or Apple Silicon.)
  2. Terminal opens and your browser shows the BRAHM Drop screen.
  3. If macOS says the app is from an unidentified developer:
        -> Right-click "BRAHM Drop.command" -> Open -> Open.
     (Only needed the first time. This build is not notarized yet.)

CONNECT YOUR PHONE
  * On the "Receive" screen you'll see a QR code and an address like
        http://192.168.x.x:53330
  * On the phone (same Wi-Fi) scan the QR with the camera — the BRAHM Drop page
    opens in the phone browser. No install needed.
  * Tap this Mac in the list, choose files -> they arrive on the Mac.

WHERE FILES ARE SAVED
  ~/Downloads/BRAHM Drop   (change it on the Settings screen)

STOP THE APP
  Press Ctrl+C in Terminal, or just close the Terminal window.

FILES IN THIS FOLDER
  BRAHM Drop.command     <- double-click this
  brahmdrop-mac-apple    (Apple Silicon build)
  brahmdrop-mac-intel    (Intel build)
